title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
headline: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
ai_overview: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers.
